pages.title: What Gauge does
pages.summary: One agency week in order: agreed work, approved time, next month's capacity and one billing packet.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.summary: Run Gauge on your computer, finish setup and add your first engagement.

pages.title: Week in review
pages.summary: The week's exceptions, agent proposals and engagement economics on one page.

pages.title: Time and approvals
pages.summary: Record time by hand or with a timer, then submit, return, approve and correct it.

pages.title: Expenses and receipts
pages.summary: Project expenses with private receipts, approved or returned by the lead.

pages.title: Staffing
pages.summary: A five-week board of who is booked, who is free and who is out, with the agent's costed alternatives.

pages.title: Billing packets
pages.summary: Prepare, approve and download one packet of approved work, and correct it with adjustments.

pages.title: Engagements and terms
pages.summary: Clients, people, engagements, terms and change orders, tasks and milestones.

pages.title: Effective-dated rates
pages.summary: Cost and bill rates that take effect on a date; approved work keeps its rate.

pages.title: People and access
pages.summary: Invite your team and give each person the role they need.

pages.title: Agents prepare, you approve
pages.summary: Let an agent you already run draft time, staffing, packets and change orders.

pages.title: Move in from Harvest
pages.summary: Preview a Harvest export, reconcile the totals, apply it and undo it if you change your mind.

pages.title: Back up and restore
pages.summary: Export every record, history and receipt, and restore it into an empty Gauge.
